text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 浅紫色宽松长袖衬衫开领，奶白高腰褶裥阔腿长裤，黑色一字带凉鞋。配饰：棕色细腰带；黑色窄框墨镜；金色细项链。按自然穿搭位置或旁置排列，无人无人台。
original_prompt: Edit this catalog image. Preserve all garments exactly, their colors and construction, on pure white. REMOVE ALL feet, toes, ankles, human skin, mannequin parts inside or below trousers. Show the pair of EMPTY black sandals separately BESIDE the trousers, viewed from above with smooth flat insoles, clearly unworn shoes. Trousers end above blank white background, nothing emerging from hems. No body parts anywhere. Keep accessories but show the black belt only ONCE, separately to the side.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
